== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Jades represent a specific level of [[advancement]] or rank for [[sacred artists]]. Individuals at this stage can utilize [[life madra]] and may employ specialized tools, such as staves, to channel their power. Some Jades serve in official capacities, such as guards or members of a sect, and may wear badges to signify their status or affiliation. While they possess significant capabilities—including the ability to use constructs to move heavy objects like boulders and soil—they are considered lower in power compared to higher ranks such as [[Irons]] or [[Underlord|Underlords]]. In certain regions like the [[Sacred Valley]], Jades are viewed as a significant force, though their sensory abilities may be described as dull compared to more powerful entities. Advancement to the [[Jade]] level is a notable milestone that can resolve certain physical ailments, though some practitioners may choose to skip this stage entirely.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Jades are characterized by a clumsy nature. They have been identified as enemies who were seen fleeing from a conflict.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Jades possess enough strength to weaken the [[Sword Sage]] to the point of being killable.}}
